_meta.role: Shared text catalog — the single record for each work; library manifests link to these by text_id and add the site-specific evidence relationship. Prevents duplicating a text that belongs to several libraries (e.g. heraclitus-b1 sits in both Ephesus and Pergamon, under different relationships).
_meta.content_note: Entries with source_repository 'corpus/heraclitus.json' resolve to full readable text via that file; entries with loaded:false are records only in this build.
